arxiv-1809-10506.title: Top-Quark Physics at the LHC
arxiv-1809-10506.creator: Sven-Olaf Moch 1 , Jürgen Reuter 2 1 II. Institut für Theoretische Physik, Universität Hamburg, Germany 2 DESY, Hamburg, Germany
arxiv-1809-10506.description: Abstract We report on the precision determination of the top-quark mass to next-to-next-to-leading order in QCD in well-defined renormalization schemes using data from the Large Hadron Collider for single-top and top-quark pair production. We also discuss the calibration of the so-called Monte Carlo top-quark mass parameter which is determined from a comparison to events with top-quark decay products.

arxiv-2011-11774.title: Five Equivalent Representations of a Phylogenetic Tree
arxiv-2011-11774.creator: Jiayue Qi and Josef Schicho
arxiv-2011-11774.description: Abstract A phylogenetic tree is a tree with a fixed set of leaves that has no vertices of degree two. In this paper, we axiomatically define four other discrete structures on the set of leaves. We prove that each of these structures is an equivalent representation of a phylogenetic tree.

arxiv-2311-04335.title: Sub-Sentence Encoder: Contrastive Learning of Propositional Semantic Representations
arxiv-2311-04335.creator: Sihao Chen Hongming Zhang Tong Chen Ben Zhou Wenhao Yu, Dian Yu, Baolin Peng, Hongwei Wang, Dan Roth, Dong Yu
arxiv-2311-04335.description: Abstract We introduce sub-sentence encoder , a contrastively-learned contextual embedding model for fine-grained semantic representation of text. In contrast to the standard practice with sentence embeddings, where the meaning of an entire sequence of text is encoded into a fixed-length vector, the sub-sentence encoder learns to produce distinct contextual embeddings corresponding to different atomic propositions , i.e.

arxiv-2402-10038.title: RS-DPO: A Hybrid Rejection Sampling and Direct Preference Optimization Method for Alignment of Large Language Models
arxiv-2402-10038.creator: Saeed Khaki, JinJin Li, Lan Ma, Liu Yang, Prathap Ramachandra
arxiv-2402-10038.description: Abstract Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) has been extensively employed to align large language models with user intent. However, proximal policy optimization (PPO) based RLHF is occasionally unstable requiring significant hyperparameter finetuning, and computationally expensive to maximize the estimated reward during alignment. Recently, direct preference optimization (DPO) is proposed to address those challenges.

arxiv-2409-05417.title: Replicability Measures for Longitudinal Information Retrieval Evaluation
arxiv-2409-05417.creator: Jüri Keller, Timo Breuer, Philipp Schaer
arxiv-2409-05417.description: Abstract Information Retrieval (IR) systems are exposed to constant changes in most components. Documents are created, updated, or deleted, the information needs are changing, and even relevance might not be static. While it is generally expected that the IR systems retain a consistent utility for the users, test collection evaluations rely on a fixed experimental setup.

arxiv-2412-04375.title: Restricted Phase Space Thermodynamics of 4D Dyonic AdS Black Holes: Insights from Kaniadakis Statistics and Emergence of Superfluid λ \lambda -Phase Transition
arxiv-2412-04375.creator: Abhishek Baruah, Prabwal Phukon a,
arxiv-2412-04375.description: Abstract We study the thermodynamics of 4 ​ D 4D dyonic AdS black hole in the Kaniadakis statistics framework using the Restricted Phase Space (RPST) formalism. This framework provides a non-extensive extension of classical statistical mechanics, drawing inspiration from relativistic symmetries and presenting a fresh perspective on black hole thermodynamics.

arxiv-2506-04979.title: Exciton-polaritons in a monolayer semiconductor coupled to van der Waals dielectric nanoantennas on a metallic mirror
arxiv-2506-04979.creator: Yadong Wang, Charalambos Louca, Sam Randerson, Xuerong Hu, Panaiot G. Zotev, Oscar Palma Chaundler, Paul Bouteyre, Casey K. Cheung, Roman Gorbachev, Yue Wang, Alexander I. Tartakovskii
arxiv-2506-04979.description: Abstract Polaritons in nanophotonic structures have attracted long-standing interest owing to their fundamental importance and potential for applications in nonlinear and quantum optics. Nanoantennas (NAs) made from high refractive index dielectrics offer a suitable platform for polariton physics thanks to the strongly confined optical Mie resonances and low optical losses in contrast to metallic NAs.

arxiv-2601-04038.title: The Power Problem for Generalized Gamma Convolutions (GGC) and Related Questions Dedicated to the memory of my colleague and friend professor emeritus Lennart Bondesson, Umeå university, Sweden
arxiv-2601-04038.creator: Tord Sjödin
arxiv-2601-04038.description: Abstract The class of generalized gamma convolutions (GGC) is closed with respect to change of scale, weak limits and addition and multiplication of independent random variables. Our main result confirms an old conjecture that GGC is also closed wrt q − q- th powers, q > 1 q>1 .

arxiv-2601-13948.title: Stream-Voice-Anon: Enhancing Utility of Real-Time Speaker Anonymization via Neural Audio Codec and Language Models
arxiv-2601-13948.creator: Nikita Kuzmin, Songting Liu, Kong Aik Lee, Eng Siong Chng
arxiv-2601-13948.description: Abstract Protecting speaker identity is crucial for online voice applications, yet streaming speaker anonymization (SA) remains underexplored. Recent research has demonstrated that neural audio codec (NAC) provides superior speaker feature disentanglement and linguistic fidelity. NAC can also be used with causal language models (LM) to enhance linguistic fidelity and prompt control for streaming tasks.

pmc-10517100.title: Catalytic performance and antibacterial behaviour with molecular docking analysis of silver and polyacrylic acid doped graphene quantum dots†
pmc-10517100.creator: Tahreem Aziz, Muhammad Imran, Ali Haider, Anum Shahzadi, Muhammad Zain Ul Abidin, Anwar Ul-Hamid, Walid Nabgan, Mohammed M. Algaradah, Ahmed M. Fouda, Muhammad Ikram
pmc-10517100.description: In this research, a fixed concentration (3 wt%) of Ag/PAA and PAA/Ag doped graphene quantum dots (GQDs) were synthesized using the co-precipitation technique. A variety of characterization techniques were employed to synthesize samples to investigate their optical, morphological, structural, and compositional analyses, antimicrobial efficacy, and dye degradation potential with molecular docking analysis.

pmc-11308118.title: Impact and Implications of Neurocognitive Dysfunction in the Management of Ischemic Heart Failure
pmc-11308118.creator: Daniela Tirziu, Michalina Kołodziejczak, Daniel Grubman, Carmen I Carrión, Lucas D Driskell, Yousif Ahmad, Mark C Petrie, Elmir Omerovic, Björn Redfors, Stephen Fremes, Jeffrey N Browndyke, Alexandra J Lansky
pmc-11308118.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Neurocognitive dysfunction is common in heart failure (HF), with 30% to 80% of patients experiencing some degree of deficits in one or more cognitive domains, including memory, attention, learning ability, executive function, and psychomotor speed. Although the mechanism is not fully understood, reduced cardiac output, comorbidities, chronic cerebral hypoperfusion, and cardioembolic brain injury leading to cerebral hypoxia and brain damage seem to trigger the neurocognitive dysfunction in HF.

pmc-11312221.title: Longitudinal associations between exclusive, dual and polytobacco use and respiratory illness among youth
pmc-11312221.creator: Luis Zavala-Arciniega, Steven Cook, Jana L Hirschtick, Yanmei Xie, Richa Mukerjee, Douglas Arenberg, Geoffrey D Barnes, David T Levy, Rafael Meza, Nancy L Fleischer
pmc-11312221.description: BackgroundThe health consequences of polytobacco use are not well understood. We evaluated prospective associations between exclusive, dual, and polytobacco use and diagnosed bronchitis, pneumonia, or chronic cough among US youth.MethodsData came from Waves 1–5 of the Population Assessment of Tobacco and Health Study.

pmc-11674648.title: Added Value of Biological Effective Dose in Dosiomics-Based Modelling of Late Rectal Bleeding in Prostate Cancer
pmc-11674648.creator: Christian A M Jongen, Wilma D Heemsbergen, Luca Incrocci, Ben J M Heijmen, Linda Rossi, Gregory M Palmer
pmc-11674648.description: Simple SummaryBy identifying patterns and voxel correlations (texture analysis), it is possible to characterize dose distributions. These dose parameters are called dosiomic features. The linear-quadratic model is a widely applied model in radiotherapy to calculate the biological effective dose for a tissue of interest based on the fraction size sensitivity, fraction size and total dose.

pmc-12532778.title: NBEA gene variant in a child with developmental disorder and epilepsy: a case report
pmc-12532778.creator: Xiaoli Huang, Wen-Lin Wu, Jingjing Song, Yang Tian, Yilan Zhou, Shitao Wei, Bin Yu, Luoxiao Qin, Sida Yang
pmc-12532778.description: The NBEA gene encodes Neurobeachin, a brain-specific kinase-anchoring protein that plays a critical role in vesicle trafficking and synaptic regulation. Pathogenic variants in NBEA are definitively associated with neurodevelopmental disorders accompanied by epilepsy, including intellectual disability, autism spectrum disorder, and myoclonic-astatic epilepsy–like phenotypes.

pmc-12613635.title: Innovative water management for vector control: the case of rice cultivation in Burkina Faso’s Vallée du Kou
pmc-12613635.creator: Kouamé Wilfred Ulrich Kouadio, Dieudonné Diloma Soma, Miriam Félicité Amara, Kelly Lionelle Ngaffo, Raymond Karlhis Yao, Emmanuel Kiendrebeogo, Hamadou Konaté, Abdoulaye Diabaté, Roch Kounbobr Dabiré, Olivier Gnankiné, Moussa Namountougou
pmc-12613635.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundA new water-saving techniques involves minimal tillage and intermittent flooding has the advantage of reducing the production of mosquito larvae, which could in turn reduce the density of adult mosquitoes. The aim of this study was to evaluate the impact of a new water-saving technique on reducing the number of Anopheles breeding sites in an area with a high density of the main malaria vector.MethodsThe study was conducted in experimental rice plots measuring 5.5 × 3.0 m (16.5 m2) from February 2024

pmc-13057056.title: Assessing three altruism facets by economic games and self-report: a multitrait-multimethod investigation
pmc-13057056.creator: Lucie Binder, Martin Schultze, Frances S Chen, Sabine Windmann
pmc-13057056.description: Reliable and valid measurement of the various components of prosociality calls for tools that capture its diverse behavioral expressions. Here, we evaluate how economic game measures derived from the Dictator Game, Public Goods Game, and Ultimatum Game as well as a novel Third-Party Intervention Paradigm correspond with their self-reported counterparts within a design informed by a multitrait–multimethod approach.

pmc-13113341.title: Serum Cytokine Profiles and Their Association with Clinical Severity in Dogs with Atopic Dermatitis
pmc-13113341.creator: Jae-Yun Ko, Min-Hee Kang, Hee-Myung Park
pmc-13113341.description: Simple SummaryCanine atopic dermatitis is a common allergic skin disease in dogs that causes chronic itching and recurrent skin inflammation. In clinical practice, veterinarians usually evaluate disease severity using owner-reported itch scores and clinician-based skin lesion scores. However, these assessments can vary and may not always reflect underlying immune activity.

pmc-13204876.title: Women with Abdominal Aortic Aneurysms Have a Different Pattern of Genetic Variability, Compared to Men
pmc-13204876.creator: Jonas Wallinder, Anders Wanhainen, Helena Åkerud, Dick Wågsäter, Martin Björck
pmc-13204876.description: Background/Objectives: The etiology behind sex differences in the prevalence of abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) can only partly be explained by environmental factors such as smoking. Genetic factors are also likely to be part of the explanation since family history is common. We hypothesized that genetic factors on AAA prevalence might be different between the sexes.

pmc-13239186.title: Organ‐Specific Microplastic Profiling and Polymer Characterization in Freshwater Fish Species of Karnataka
pmc-13239186.creator: Kuruveetil Manikandan Ashitha, Anjali Tamrakar, Gopika Melethil, Anish Kumar Warrier, Liuwei Wang
pmc-13239186.description: Microplastic (MP) contamination is an emerging threat to freshwater ecosystems and food security. The objective of this study was to provide a comprehensive baseline assessment of MP abundance, polymer composition, and tissue‐specific distribution across five organs (gut, gills, liver, gonads, and muscle) of two economically vital species Labeo rohita and Pangasius pangasius, in Udupi, Karnataka, India.

pmc-13240227.title: Conditional Knockout of Paxillin in Mouse Cortical Pyramidal Neurons Does Not Impair Axon Outgrowth or Corpus Callosum Size
pmc-13240227.creator: Katelyn Rygel, Kasey Gillespie, Kristy Welshhans
pmc-13240227.description: Axon growth is an essential cellular process during neural development, and its dysregulation contributes to numerous neurodevelopmental disorders. During axon growth, extracellular signals direct neurons to extend projections that connect with their synaptic targets. Paxillin is a key member of adhesion sites that control motility by linking the intracellular actin cytoskeleton to the extracellular matrix.

pmc-13290086.title: FDA-approved antisense oligonucleotide therapies for duchenne muscular dystrophy: current status and future outlook
pmc-13290086.creator: Hidenori Moriyama, Shiori Moriyama, Toshifumi Yokota

pmc-13649552.title: HIV dominates T-cell immune responses in HIV–HBV co-infection and is associated with increased HIV reservoir transcription
pmc-13649552.creator: Helena Lamptey, Abigail Naa Adjorkor Pobee, James Odame Aboagye, Jonathan Klutse, Anthony Twumasi Boateng, Christopher Zab-Yen Abana, Dzidzor Aku Attoh, Ephraim Mawufemor Kofi Kanda, John Atanniba, Prince Adom Nartey, Yeena Abla Tay, Ebenezer Adjei-Gati, Prince Charles O. Lamptey, Kwadwo Asamoah Kus
pmc-13649552.description: Due to the effectiveness of antiretroviral therapy (ART), Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) infection is now managed as a chronic condition. However, people with HIV (PWH) remain susceptible to co-infections, including Hepatitis B virus (HBV), with 15% of PWH in Africa being co-infected.

pmc-13669293.title: Epigenetically silencing gluconeogenic enzyme PCK1 by EZH2 promotes renal tubulointerstitial fibrosis
pmc-13669293.creator: Ming Wu, Pinglan Lin, Zhiqiang Yan, Yanzhe Wang, Anna Rinaldi, Pietro E Cippà, Di Huang, Jiayi Qiao, Aidong Yang, Bo Tan, Chaoyang Ye, Dongping Chen
pmc-13669293.description: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is a leading cause of global morbidity. The kidney is a major gluconeogenic organ, and impaired renal gluconeogenesis contributes to CKD, yet the regulatory mechanisms remain poorly understood. Here we show that enhancer of zeste homolog 2 (EZH2), a histone H3K27 trimethyltransferase, epigenetically suppresses renal gluconeogenesis and drives tubulointerstitial fibrosis.
